findings.current: The young man reflected in those eyes was no longer simply Jin Mukyung.
findings.defect: “No longer simply” softens the source’s emphatic statement that the young man reflected in their eyes was not Jin Mukyung; the following lines recast him as hope and revenge.
findings.rationale: The Korean says his name was not Jin Mukyung, then identifies him as the hope they must save and the revenge they will return upon their enemies.
findings.replacement: The young man reflected in their eyes now was not Jin Mukyung.

findings.defect: This repeats the narration that he murmured immediately before the dialogue.
findings.rationale: The Korean has one speech attribution before the quoted line; the assembled English adds a second.

summary: The translation is largely faithful, but it weakens one identity beat and duplicates a speech attribution.
